animation.rest_pose: bind pose = the approved static pose; every bone rest rotation is identity (model axes)
animation.root_motion: none - clips are in place; bone "root" never moves, "hips"/"pelvis" carry the vertical bob only. Move the object along the path at <clip>Speed x timeScale m/s.
animation.loop: every clip: first key == last key (THREE.LoopRepeat, no pop)
animation.interpolation: LINEAR (rotation slerp), 24-25 keys per gait cycle
animation.skinning: max 3 influences (normalized UNSIGNED_BYTE weights), props rigid to one bone
animation.clone: use registry cloneModel()/loadModel() (SkeletonUtils.clone equivalent) - never Object3D.clone() for rigged models

env.notes: Every env GLB = 1 mesh / 1 material / 1 draw call (InstancedMesh-ready). Vegetation + tufts share env/textures/env_atlas.png (external uri, loaded once by registry.js); ground/decal pieces use their tiling texture. See README "Environment set".

atlas.filter: NEAREST, no mipmaps, SRGB, RepeatWrapping (needed for the season offset)

layout.swatchGrid: x 0-63 of each band: 8x8 cells of 8 px, opaque solid swatches
layout.sprites: x 64-255 of each band: 4 sprites of 48x64 px, alpha 0/255: cheatgrass (frame 0), weeds (frame 1), thistle (frame 2), frostgrass (frame 3)
layout.authoredBand: summer (0); swap season with map.offset.y = band * 0.25
layout.topRule: faces with normal.y > 0.45 use <swatch>_top (bark colour in bands 0-2, SNOW in band 3)
